harness: in-session read of the emitted packet file; no API-key judge harness exists in this repo
convention: A meaning group is `same` only if EVERY member shown expresses one and the same sense, judged on referent rather than on the source dictionary's own numbering: where one dictionary splits into two members what another dictionary's single member unites, that is one sense. A group whose members are individually defensible but merge two distinct referents (the granularity-many-to-many case) is `different`, and the reason says so. `unsure` is used when the entry shown is grammatical apparatus, a bare cross-reference, or narrowed by a parenthetical in a way the card cannot resolve.
